notes.title: Weapon-Update v30250 released!
notes.notes:
A new Update for Strike Force: Arctic Storm has been released.

This updates reworks the way recoil is handled in Strike Force: Arctic Storm to a more controllable way. Also the Engine was updated to Unreal Engine 4.13.

Changelog: 
[code]
- reworked weapon recoil
- engine update to Unreal Engine 4.13
[/code]
